info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Banking Operational Services Reward-v5-spec
info.description: The Banking Operational Services Rewards API enables financial institutions to manage and distribute rewards within banking operational services. This API allows users to initiate the creation of reward offerings tailored to customer engagement and loyalty programs. Typical consumers include banks and fintech companies looking to enhance customer loyalty through personalized rewards. Utilize this API to streamline reward processes and enhance customer satisfaction across banking services.

post.summary: Create a new reward in operational services.
post.description: This endpoint allows developers to create a new reward in the operational services system. It expects the necessary data in the request body to successfully create the reward and returns the created reward details upon success.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a reward operation request in the operational services context. It contains the necessary data for the processing of rewards.
